With reference to your letter No.33 of February, 11, 1934, regarding certain Surur negro who claims to have been slave of a man named Sultan Musaggard.

I looked up for a man of this name in Sharjah and Dibai and could not trace him at all, but there are three other slaves whose names are:

1. Aman bin Faragh.
2. Zuwaid bin Mabrook.
3. Daaji bin Khamis.

and who belong to Saif bin Hamad al Abduli. These slaves work for him in diving and escaped from Ras-el-Khaima.
